# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.12

## AI settings and model updates

- Moves **Test AI Service** into **AI settings**.
- When a new shared AI model configuration is acknowledged, opens AI settings, runs the service test automatically, and displays its result.
- Shows the primary model and all configured fallback models in order.
- Extends the device status response to return the complete ordered fallback list.

Existing projects and application data are preserved. The application checks the signed stable update manifest at startup; users can also check manually from **About**.
